title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Stockport £30,000 per annum + study + benefits

Join a successful manufacturing business where your contribution really counts.

Are you an organised, detail-oriented finance professional looking for your next opportunity within a supportive team? This is a great opportunity to join an established packaging business in Stockport, as an Accounts Assistant, supporting the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you ll play an important role in keeping financial records accurate, ensuring transactions are processed efficiently and helping the business maintain effective financial controls.

This is a varied, hands-on position offering the opportunity to build on your existing accounts experience, develop your skills and gain broader exposure to the finance function.

The role

Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider business, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accurate coding, supporting documentation and approvals.
- Maintaining customer and supplier accounts and allocating receipts and payments.
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies or unreconciled transactions.
- Supporting credit control by monitoring outstanding balances, issuing statements and following up overdue invoices.
- Checking employee expenses and maintaining petty cash records.
- Assisting with month-end activities, including ledger checks, accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules.
- Providing financial information for VAT returns, audits and management reporting.
- Responding to customer and supplier queries professionally and helping resolve issues promptly.
- Maintaining accurate, organised and confidential financial records.
- Identifying opportunities to improve routine processes and supporting the wider finance team as required.

About you

You ll be numerate, methodical and comfortable working with financial information, with a strong eye for detail and a proactive approach to getting things done.

We re looking for someone with:
- A good understanding of basic bookkeeping and purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Strong numerical skills and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting and filtering.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach to customer and supplier queries.
- The ability to work independently on routine tasks while contributing positively to a team.
- A responsible approach to confidentiality and sensitive financial information.

Previous experience in an accounts, bookkeeping or finance administration role would be advantageous. AAT qualified, studying towards AAT, or equivalent practical experience would also be welcomed.

Experience with bank reconciliations, credit control, month-end processes or accounting software would be beneficial, although a willingness to learn is just as important.

What s on offer?
- £30,000 annual salary plus benefits
- The opportunity to join an established business.
- A varied role with exposure to several areas of finance.
- Direct support and development from the Finance Manager.
- The opportunity to strengthen your accounting skills and develop your experience within a busy finance function.

Interested?

If you re looking for a hands-on Accounts Assistant role where you can make a valuable contribution, build your experience and become part of a supportive finance team, we d love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Accounts Assistant

title: Credit Controller
description:

- Allocating customer payments and supporting month-end reconciliations.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, pricing discrepancies and customer debit notes.
- Working closely with sales, commercial and logistics teams to resolve queries.

title: Credit Controller
description:
An exciting opportunity awaits you with a leading organisation, as they search for an enthusiastic Credit Controller to join their vibrant finance team in Altrincham!

This is your chance to become a key player in safeguarding cash flow, maintaining impeccable sales ledger records, and ensuring timely invoicing, all while thriving in a truly supportive and knowledgeable environment. You'll be surrounded by colleagues who value inclusivity, offer flexible working options, and provide ongoing training to help you shine and grow. If you're eager to make a real impact, build strong relationships with retail customers, and see your attention to detail and teamwork celebrated every day, this role is tailor-made for you.

Step into a collaborative finance department where your expertise will be at the heart of business success - protecting cash flow and supporting commercial operations with every action you take.

Enjoy flexible working opportunities and continuous training that empower you to develop professionally while maintaining a healthy work-life balance, so you can flourish both inside and outside the office.

Work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in an inclusive environment that values your input, encourages growth leadership, and supports your personal development through every stage of your career journey.

Responsibilities:

Raise and issue accurate sales invoices and credit notes based on customer purchase orders, delivery documentation, and agreed pricing, ensuring all transactions are processed swiftly and efficiently.

Check invoices for accuracy before despatch, collaborating with sales, warehouse, or customer teams to resolve any discrepancies quickly so clients receive flawless documentation.

Support the transition towards automation by partnering with IT and other departments to facilitate EDI implementation, helping streamline processes for greater efficiency.

Maintain precise sales ledger records by correctly coding and allocating all transactions, guaranteeing data integrity across the board.

Proactively manage a portfolio of customer accounts by chasing outstanding debt via phone, email, and customer portals within agreed credit terms to keep cash flow strong.

Produce regular aged debt reports on a weekly or monthly basis, identifying overdue balances early and escalating risk accounts as needed to protect financial stability.

Build effective working relationships with customer accounts payable teams to resolve payment delays and queries promptly, fostering trust and collaboration.

Monitor customer credit limits closely, flagging accounts approaching or exceeding thresholds while working with management on credit risk decisions for optimal outcomes.

Allocate incoming customer remittances against invoices accurately and promptly to support timely cash collection and seamless reconciliation.

Prepare debtor reporting and commentary for the Finance Manager, highlighting trends, risks, and cash collection forecasts that inform strategic decision-making.

Experience Needed:

Proven experience in a sales ledger, credit control, or accounts receivable role within a B2 B/wholesale or manufacturing environment

Experience dealing with large retail customers - including familiarity with portals, EDI systems, and retailer-specific documentation

Working knowledge of credit control best practices as well as aged debt management techniques is essential for delivering results in this role.

Confident use of accounting or ERP systems combined with proficiency in Excel (including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP functions and pivot tables)

Strong numerical accuracy paired with exceptional attention to detail empowers you to maintain precise records even under pressure.

Professional communication skills allow you to chase payments diplomatically while resolving queries collaboratively with customers

Excellent organisational abilities equip you to manage high volumes of transactions

What sets this company apart:

This organisation truly stands out thanks to its unwavering commitment to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member's contributions are celebrated! Flexible working arrangements mean you can balance professional ambitions with personal wellbeing- making it easier than ever to thrive both at work and at home. Training opportunities abound so you can expand your skillset while advancing your career within a supportive environment led by knowledgeable professionals who champion growth leadership. Collaboration is at the heart of everything here: everyone works together towards common goals - whether it's improving processes through automation or resolving complex queries across departments. The culture prioritises teamwork over hierarchy; ideas are welcomed from all levels so you can make meaningful impact regardless of your position. With generous pension contributions available alongside ongoing development initiatives tailored specifically for finance professionals like yourself, this is the perfect place for those seeking long-term career satisfaction within a respected industry leader.

title: Finance Administrator

title: Finance Assistant / Stock Controller
description:
Finance Assistant / Stock Controller

A varied finance opportunity combining reporting, stock control and improvement work in a hands-on manufacturing setting. It suits someone with relevant finance, accounts, stock control or manufacturing experience and strong Excel skills.

If you've also worked in the following roles, we'd also like to hear from you: Accounts Assistant, Finance Officer, Accounts Administrator, Finance Administrator, Assistant Accountant, Inventory Controller, Stock Control Assistant, Accounts Clerk

This job is officially known within the business as Assistant to Financial Controller

SALARY: £25,000 - £27,500 per annum + Benefits

LOCATION: Hyde, Greater Manchester, North West England

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, Permanent

WORKING HOURS: 35 Hours per Week

JOB OVERVIEW

This is a varied opportunity to combine finance support, stock accuracy and business improvement in a practical manufacturing environment. The Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will support reporting, reconciliations, audits and inventory activity.

Working with production, purchasing and warehouse teams brings broad exposure across finance and operations. The Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will help improve stock accuracy, support ERP Bills of Materials and investigate discrepancies.

Alongside operational finance, the Finance Assistant / Stock Controller will support the Financial Controller, coordinate key information and contribute to ad hoc projects and continuous improvement.

DUTIES

Your duties as the Finance Assistant / Stock Controller include:
- Diary and Deadline Coordination: Manage the Financial Controller's diary, calendar, meetings and key deadlines
- Finance Query Support: Act as a first point of contact for finance queries, taking calls and directing requests as required
- Reporting and Documentation: Prepare reports, analysis, presentations and meeting documentation
- Stock Accuracy Relationships: Build strong relationships with production, purchasing and warehouse teams to improve stock accuracy
- Financial Reporting Support: Assist with month-end and year-end reporting, balance sheet reconciliations and inventory-related reporting
- Audit Support: Prepare schedules and provide information to auditors for year-end audit activity
- ERP and BOM Support: Support implementation and maintenance of Bills of Materials (BOMs) within the ERP system
- Stock Management and Checks: Assist with stock management, counts, valuations, discrepancy investigations and ad hoc spot checks in the factory and warehouse
- Intercompany Liaison: Liaise with intercompany stakeholders regarding stock, reporting and reconciliations
- Continuous Improvement and Projects: Contribute to finance and operational improvement initiatives, ad hoc projects and wider business requirements

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL
- Previous experience in finance, accounts, stock control or a manufacturing environment
- Strong Excel and analytical skills
- Excellent organisation and time management abilities
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work across multiple departments
- HNC/HND qualification (or equivalent financial qualification)
- Proactive, highly organised, meticulous and detail-oriented approach
- Comfortable working in the office and on the factory floor
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Team-oriented approach with the ability to build relationships across the business
- Ability to work methodically, independently and efficiently within deadlines
- Willingness to take ownership and drive continuous improvement initiatives

DESIRABLE
- Manufacturing environment and ERP systems experience

BENEFITS
- 28 days' holiday including statutory days, rising by one day after one completed year of service
- Life assurance covering annual salary
- Subsidised canteen offering freshly cooked meals and sandwiches every day
- Free car parking
- Employee Assistance Programme with counselling support, legal guidance and medical advice from qualified nurses for the employee and immediate family
